academyLanding.description: Master Factory Droid through hands-on courses — from fundamentals to advanced workflows, at your own pace. Work through three tiers of courses — Droid Essentials, Droid Specialist, and Droid Master — earning a certification as you complete each tier. Each module's quiz unlocks once you pass the prerequisites in earlier modules.

fundamentals.title: Droid 101: Fundamentals
fundamentals.description: Learn the fundamentals of using Droid from installation to advanced autonomy settings.

useCases.title: Droid 102: Use-cases
useCases.description: Explore common engineering use-cases with Droid: writing production code, debugging, refactoring, exploring codebases, and writing tests.

customizations.title: Droid 201: Droid Customizations
customizations.description: Master Factory customization features: AGENTS.md, Skills, Custom Droids, Hooks, Plugins, Marketplace, and power-user techniques.

automations.title: Droid 202: Automations
automations.description: Run Droid on a schedule or in response to events to automate recurring engineering and operational work.

missions.title: Droid 203: Missions
missions.description: Master multi-agent orchestration for large-scale development projects with structured planning and execution.

exec.title: Droid 301: Droid Exec
exec.description: Master headless automation with Droid Exec for CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, and interactive applications.

agentReadiness.title: Droid 302: Agent Readiness
agentReadiness.description: Understand your codebase maturity and prepare for autonomous AI-assisted development.

installation.title: Installation & Setup
installation.description: Install Factory CLI, authenticate your account, and launch your first Droid session.

firstSession.title: Your First Droid Session
firstSession.description: Learn how to start Droid, ask questions, make code changes, and manage your session context.

droidSettings.title: Understanding Droid Settings
droidSettings.description: Understand the various settings and configurations available in Droid to customize your experience.

specMode.title: Spec Mode
specMode.description: Learn how to use Spec Mode to improve planning and generate better results.

toolsMcp.title: Connecting To Tools With MCP And CLI Utilities
toolsMcp.description: Learn what MCP is, how to add servers, and how to use CLI utilities.

bestPractices.title: General Best Practices For Using Droid
bestPractices.description: Learn the best practices for writing prompts, implementing large features, and using auto-run effectively.

writingProductionCode.title: Writing Production Code
writingProductionCode.description: Collaborate with Droid to ship production-grade code with clear specs, iterative implementation, and reviewable changes.

debugging.title: Debugging with Droid
debugging.description: Use Droid as a debugging partner to isolate faults, reason about stack traces, and narrow down root causes.

refactoring.title: Refactoring Safely
refactoring.description: Refactor large or unfamiliar code with Droid while preserving behavior through tests, incremental edits, and explicit contracts.

exploringCodebases.title: Exploring Unfamiliar Codebases
exploringCodebases.description: Onboard faster into a new repository by using Droid to map architecture, trace call paths, and summarize key modules.

writingTests.title: Writing Tests
writingTests.description: Generate and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests with Droid while keeping suites fast and reliable.

agentsMd.title: AGENTS.md & /init
agentsMd.description: Learn how to write effective AGENTS.md files and use the /init command to bootstrap your project context.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Learn to create and manage Skills — reusable capabilities that extend what Droid can do.

customDroids.title: Custom Droids
customDroids.description: Create specialized subagents with constrained toolsets for focused tasks like code review, security scanning, and documentation.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Configure deterministic lifecycle actions with Hooks for formatting, logging, notifications, and custom permissions.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Install and manage Plugins — distributable bundles of skills, commands, agents, hooks, and MCP servers.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Subscribe to external marketplaces, or create internal ones to share and discover plugins across your organization.

whatAreAutomations.title: What Are Automations
whatAreAutomations.description: Understand how Droid Automations run on your behalf on a schedule or in response to events to handle recurring work.

scheduledAutomations.title: Scheduled Automations
scheduledAutomations.description: Run Droid on a cadence to keep dashboards fresh, triage issues, rotate credentials, and produce recurring reports.

eventTriggers.title: Event-Triggered Automations
eventTriggers.description: Hook Droid into your systems so inbound events — pull requests, alerts, webhooks, or ticket updates — trigger the right automation.

writingAutomationPrompts.title: Writing Effective Automation Prompts
writingAutomationPrompts.description: Write durable prompts for Automations with scoped inputs, explicit success criteria, and clear failure modes.

whatAreMissions.title: What are Missions
whatAreMissions.description: Understand Missions — a structured approach to large-scale work with collaborative planning and orchestrated execution.

planningPhase.title: The Planning Phase
planningPhase.description: Learn why the planning phase is critical to Mission success and how to build effective plans with milestones and validation contracts.

execution.title: Mission Execution & Workers
execution.description: Understand how Missions execute work through worker sessions, feature assignment, and skill-aware orchestration.

validation.title: Validation & Quality
validation.description: Learn how Missions ensure quality through automated validators, milestone checkpoints, and the scrutiny and user testing workflows.

missionControl.title: Working with Mission Control
missionControl.description: Learn how to monitor, intervene, and redirect Missions through Mission Control, and how configuration inheritance works.

whatIsDroidExec.title: What is Droid Exec
whatIsDroidExec.description: Understand Droid Exec headless mode, its execution model, and get started with basic commands.

autonomyAndOutput.title: Autonomy & Output Formats
autonomyAndOutput.description: Configure autonomy levels for secure automation and choose the right output format for your workflow.

githubActions.title: GitHub Actions Integration
githubActions.description: Integrate Droid Exec with GitHub Actions for automated PR reviews, documentation updates, and security scanning.

codeReview.title: Automated Code Review
codeReview.description: Set up the Factory GitHub App for automated code review with custom instructions and severity levels.

interactiveApps.title: Building Interactive Apps
interactiveApps.description: Learn the core pattern for building interactive applications that stream Droid responses in real-time.

codeReviewPowerUser.title: Code Review with Droid
codeReviewPowerUser.description: Use the /review command for AI-powered code analysis with multiple review types, custom instructions, and severity levels.

whatIsAgentReadiness.title: What is Agent Readiness
whatIsAgentReadiness.description: Understand the Agent Readiness Model and its vision for autonomous software development.

readinessLevels.title: How to Improve Your Agent Readiness Level
readinessLevels.description: Use Droid and the readiness reports to identify gaps and take actionable steps to advance your codebase maturity.
